name: elevation-bands-nagpur
_provenance: FABDEM V1-2 (Hawker et al., University of Bristol; satellite-derived 30 m DEM with buildings and forests removed) via Google Earth Engine, classified into ground-height bands and clipped to the official corporation boundaries. Bands are honest at ~30 m horizontal / ~2 m vertical accuracy - read them as bands, not spot heights.
